# awscontrib_connect_hours_of_operation_override (Resource)

Manages an Amazon Connect hours-of-operation override.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awscontrib_connect_hours_of_operation_override" "example" {
  instance_id           = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-111111111111"
  hours_of_operation_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-222222222222"

  name           = "holiday closure"
  description    = "Closed for a public holiday"
  effective_from = "2026-12-24"
  effective_till = "2026-12-26"
  override_type  = "CLOSED"

  recurrence = {
    frequency    = "MONTHLY"
    interval     = 1
    by_month_day = 25
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effective_from` (String) Date on which the override becomes effective, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- `effective_till` (String) Date through which the override is effective, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- `hours_of_operation_id` (String) Parent hours-of-operation identifier.
- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier.
- `name` (String) Override name.
- `override_type` (String) Override behavior: STANDARD, OPEN, or CLOSED.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional override description. Removing a stored description requires replacement because the Amazon Connect API cannot clear it.
- `recurrence` (Attributes) Optional recurrence pattern. Removing an existing recurrence requires replacement because the Amazon Connect API cannot clear it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurrence))
- `time_windows` (Attributes Set) Unordered day/time windows for the override. Each time uses zero-padded HH:MM format. STANDARD and CLOSED overrides may omit windows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_windows))

### Read-Only

- `override_id` (String) Hours-of-operation override identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--recurrence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurrence`

Required:

- `frequency` (String) Recurrence frequency: WEEKLY, MONTHLY, or YEARLY.
- `interval` (Number) Number of frequency units between occurrences, from 1 through 6.

Optional:

- `by_month` (Number) Optional month number from 1 through 12.
- `by_month_day` (Number) Optional month day from -1 through 31, excluding 0.
- `by_weekday_occurrence` (Number) Optional weekday occurrence from -1 through 4, excluding 0.


<a id="nestedatt--time_windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_windows`

Required:

- `closes` (String) Closing time in zero-padded HH:MM format, from 00:00 through 23:59.
- `day` (String) Day to which the override applies.
- `opens` (String) Opening time in zero-padded HH:MM format, from 00:00 through 23:59.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import awscontrib_connect_hours_of_operation_override.example 'aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-111111111111:aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-333333333333:aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-444444444444'
```
